vulnerability.name: USN-9159-1
vulnerability.description: Stephen Fewer and Tomer Schwartz discovered that nginx did not correctly handle certain memory operations. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code. This issue only affected Ubuntu 16.04 LTS, Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS and Ubuntu 26.10. (CVE-2026-123007)  Albert Ebb Metnir and Nir Ohfeld discovered that nginx did not correctly handle certain reusable HTTP/2 connections. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code. This issue only affected Ubuntu 16.04 LTS, Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS and Ubuntu 26.10. (CVE-2026-123633)  It was discovered that nginx did not correctly handle certain memory operations. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-113425)  It was discovered that nginx did not correctly handle resolving certain names or addresses. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-123634)  It was discovered that nginx did not correctly handle certain TLS connections. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS and Ubuntu 26.10. (CVE-2026-118899)  It was discovered that nginx did not correctly handle certain client certificate validations. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to bypass client certificate verifications. This issue only affected Ubuntu 26.04 LTS and Ubuntu 26.10. (CVE-2026-120967)  It was discovered that nginx did not correctly handle certain reusable HTTP/3 connections. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code. This issue only affected Ubuntu 26.04 LTS and Ubuntu 26.10. (CVE-2026-121810)  Vivek Parikh discovered that nginx did not correctly handle parsing certain ClientHello messages. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to leak sensitive information. This issue only affected Ubuntu 26.04 LTS and Ubuntu 26.10. (CVE-2026-123640)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in nginx.
